Embeddings and rerankers for search and retrieval: text, code, multimodal, contextualized chunks.

## API key

1. Open [dashboard.voyageai.com](https://dashboard.voyageai.com/organization/api-keys) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** A secret key from the Voyage dashboard.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add voyage
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  voyage: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Voyage AI's [API](https://docs.voyageai.com/reference/embeddings-api) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show voyage` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** voyage-4 $0.06 per million tokens; the first 200 million tokens of the voyage-4 family are free per account.

**Rate limits:** 2000 a minute. 2,000 requests a minute at tier 1, doubled at tier 2, tripled at tier 3; tokens per minute vary by model.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Voyage%20AI).
